## Implementation and contracts
<!-- Explain behavior, public API/schema/config/data changes and alternatives considered. -->

## Verification evidence
- [ ] Relevant real tests pass on this PR head.
- [ ] Build, lint, static and documentation checks pass where configured.
- [ ] Success, boundary and failure paths are covered where relevant.
- [ ] Manual or target-hardware verification includes exact environment and steps, if applicable.
- [ ] No check, metric, screenshot or capability is described as evidence unless actually produced.

## Security, compatibility and operations
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal data or machine-specific paths were added.
- [ ] Permissions and workflow changes follow least privilege.
- [ ] Dependencies, licenses and vulnerabilities were reviewed when applicable.
- [ ] Existing API/data/configuration contracts and supported platforms were considered.
- [ ] Destructive operations have a safe migration, backup or rollback path.

## Documentation and release
- [ ] README and relevant guides match the implementation.
- [ ] Screenshots are current and show the actual application; diagrams are labelled as diagrams.
- [ ] Release notes and migration notes are updated when needed.
- [ ] Known limitations and follow-up debt are recorded.

## Risk and rollback
**Risk:** Low / Moderate / High / Critical  
**Migration:** None / Describe  
**Rollback or recovery:** Not required / Describe  
**Known limitations:** <!-- Explicitly list, or say "None known after the checks above". -->

## Reviewer checklist
- [ ] Scope is focused and the full diff was inspected.
- [ ] Tests validate behavior, not merely restate implementation.
- [ ] Documentation and claims are evidence-based.
- [ ] Required CI checks and independent review are complete before merge.
